description: Every inbound route of the Ever Platform connection module (prefix /api/v1). health answers signed-in users; operator routes answer the operator of a self-hosted installation only (SUPER_ADMIN_ACCOUNT_UID, EVER_OPERATOR_UIDS) and 404 to anyone else and on Ever Cloud; workspace routes answer the workspace's admin only (403 otherwise); the export route answers its own account only (404 otherwise). Without EVER_CONNECT_ENABLED=true none of them exists.
